lessons_used: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption, adoption visual/photo improvements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact grid, style stage redesign, photo callouts), split-view path layouts, session reset safeguard hints, background readiness hints, initial post-adoption sign-in relocation, and wait progress checklists/carousels consistently won.

Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners/flows, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, and interactive sound/visual wait progress hurt performance.

No clear effect seen: Background/audio notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, subsequent sign-in reorderings, waiting overlay hints and time indicators, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, pre-upload style inspections, custom pet style selectors, split-view path screens, session safeguard hints, background hints, and wait progress checklists/carousels performed better than predicted.

Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, initial post-adoption sign-in relocation, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Adoption visual and photo enhancements (style selectors, inspection screens, compact photo grids, quality callouts), split-view path layouts, wait progress checklists/carousels, background readiness hints, session reset safeguard hints, and compact welcome dashboard redesigns won.

Hurt performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, path activation incentives, interactive sound/visual wait progress, pre-certificate sign-in reordering, and most desktop finish guidance banners or spotlight/video flows hurt performance.

No clear effect seen: Audio/background notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, waiting time indicators/overlay hints, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, full bleed welcome redesigns, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspections, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboard redesigns, session safeguard hints, background readiness hints, post-adoption waiting auth reorders, and wait progress checklists performed better than predicted.

Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, pre-certificate sign-in reorders, instant activation highlights, split-view story intros, and all tests resulting in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.
